quick-recovery-rank15.scope: Stock session records startup modifiers 1052 +3 and 1057 +7 with Quick Recovery loaded at rank 15. Sweep consumption and loadout comparison remain open.

script.source: RestoreRSI_Test admits a dead friendly player. RestoreRSI_DirectObject sets 1 HP and 1 IS, plays Stand/Action_Resurrect with ability 325, sends the two result notices, and flags the caster when the recipient is flagged.
script.runtime: AbilityResurrection validates the target and pending consent, publishes vitals, stand, and both notices, and propagates the recipient's PvP flag on approval.
script.test: PR693 verifies living refusal and an unflagged recipient visibly standing at 1 HP/1 IS. PR696 verifies a flagged recipient, no caster flag while the offer is pending, and the caster flag plus stand on approval. The headless replay verifies the paired movement and transmitted flag. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/693#issuecomment-7068778340 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/696#issuecomment-7069292847

behavior-tests.runtime: Restore RSI retains the normal admission, resource and reuse checks and completes through the native approval RPC.
behavior-tests.test: PR693 verifies the no-cost living refusal and the ordinary consent/stand path.
